title: Kidney biopsy
what: Through a puncture in your back, the doctor uses a thin needle to take a tiny piece of kidney for testing. It is done with local numbing and ultrasound guidance.
why: When there is protein or blood in the urine and the kidneys are not working well, to find the exact cause; sometimes after a kidney transplant.
duration: the procedure itself usually takes 20 to 40 minutes, then bed rest for several hours, often a night in hospital; results usually in 1 to 2 weeks
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners. Your doctor will decide if anything needs to change
High blood pressure. It needs to be brought down beforehand

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Before the biopsy, clotting, blood and urine tests, and blood pressure are checked.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually no food for 6 to 8 hours before. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Hospital
prepare.text: After a kidney biopsy, people usually stay in hospital for a day. Bring your things.

bring: Your referral, tests, and kidney images
Things for a day in hospital
steps: An IV line is put in a vein
You lie on your stomach with a pillow under your belly
The doctor chooses a spot on your back using ultrasound
The skin is cleaned and numbed with an injection
You are asked to hold your breath for a few seconds
A tiny piece of tissue is taken with a thin needle, sometimes 2 or 3 times
A pressure bandage is put on
feel: A prick and stinging from the numbing
A click and pressure as the tissue is taken
Afterward, your lower back may ache
after: Lie strictly on your back for several hours. This lowers the risk of bleeding
Drink water and watch the color of your urine
Slightly pink urine the first time can happen
No lifting or sports for 1 to 2 weeks. Ask your doctor
red_flags: Bright red urine or urine with clots: call emergency services
Severe pain in the lower back or belly, dizziness, or weakness: call emergency services

faq.q: Why do I need to lie down for so long?
faq.a: The kidney has a rich blood supply. Rest helps the puncture site close.

faq.q: Will my kidney work worse after the biopsy?
faq.a: No. Only a very small piece is taken. It does not affect how the kidney works.

reminders.text: Kidney biopsy tomorrow. Pack for a day in hospital. Eat only until the time your clinic gave you.
